name: ec-planner
description: PlanCraft — Event & Celebration Planner with Google ADK Agent Service

scripts.dev:agent: cd services/agent && uv run uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:adk-web: cd services/agent && uv run adk web --port 8080 --allow_origins '*'
scripts.test: npm run test:agent && npm run test:frontend
